# Independent audit: joint cap budgets force strict midpoint capture

Audited source: `candidate 8d217f8bc1752ff8`.
The proof is PASS. One wording correction has been sent to the author:
edge midpoints are strictly inside the capturing halfplane, but they are
not in the relative interior of the two-dimensional set K intersect H,
since they remain on the triangle boundary.

For a strict vertex cap the intercept identity
alpha_j/u+alpha_k/v=1 and area fraction uv are exact. Their AM–GM
consequence is q_i>=4 alpha_j alpha_k. The argument excluding a source
coordinate at least one half correctly uses a different cap: its
one-variable mass is alpha_2 u^2/(u-alpha_1), decreasing for
alpha_1<u<=1 when alpha_1>=1/2. Its endpoint value is at least one half.

The maximum-coordinate step uses monotonicity of 2z(1-z) on [1/3,1/2),
and the gap at z=5/14 is 11/27342. The minimum-coordinate product bound
is valid even if the extrema of the allowed interval are not attained:
(a-5/14)(b-5/14)>0 implies the stated weak bound directly. It yields
m>=9/28+11/39060. Thus the strict interval (9/28,5/14) is justified.

If an intercept u<=1/2, its denominator u-b is positive and u<2b,
because b>9/28>1/4. Therefore e u^2/(u-b) decreases up to one half,
yielding q_1>=e/(2-4b). The other two AM–GM bounds sum to
4(1-b-e)(b+e). No independence of actual cap choices is assumed.

On the enclosing closed rectangle the partial derivative in b is at
least 63/25-12/7=141/175>0. At b=9/28, concavity in e places the minimum
at an endpoint. The two values are 1341/980 and 269/196, with the first
smaller; its gap above 125/93 is 2213/91140. All denominators remain
positive. This excludes equality u=1/2 as well as smaller intercepts.

Only strict capture by the respective halfplane is proved; no unique
signature at a midpoint follows, as the source correctly emphasizes.

Exact arithmetic check (Python fractions, rerun with the audit):

    c=128/279
    2*(5/14)*(9/14)-c = 11/27342
    9/14-7*c/10-9/28 = 11/39060
    63/25-12/7 = 141/175
    F(9/28,9/28) = 1341/980
    F(9/28,5/14) = 269/196
    1341/980-125/93 = 2213/91140
note: Mathematical discussion retained to expose corrections and limitations. This is not a verification run, accepted premise, or approval of the revised submission. Association follows explicit source-document references, not an inferred dependency.
